Create X12 Indices

Source: R/create_index.R
create_index.Rd

Create X12 Indices

Arguments

x

raw X12 text input

...

dots

Value

an <hcc::IndexX12> S7 object

Examples

create_index(x12_EX$`820`$`218`)
